pages.title: Nature
pages.text: The oldest school, and the gentlest. Nature magic does not command the world; it $(l)encourages$() it.$(br2)Like the other schools, it must be opened in the Spellbook for $(l)5 Knowledge$().

$(l)Verdant Growth$() (25 mana)$(br)Crops, saplings and flowers nearby surge with life.$(br2)$(l)Wellspring$() (40 mana)$(br)Heals every friend around you: players, animals, pets and villagers. You mend a little too.$(br2)$(l)Call of the Wild$() (70 mana, Mastery)$(br)Spirit wolves answer your call and fight beside you, then fade.
